bullets: Save money with free AIs: the welcome screen and the Get free AIs card list every free AI with the right button. Install sets up an app for you, Sign in opens its own sign-in window, Get it opens a download page, and Get key opens the page for a free key with a box to paste it. Set up all free AIs does them one after another.

Gemini CLI is no longer offered: Google retired it for personal accounts and replaced it with Antigravity. If it is still on your PC, Meldmind says so plainly and uses Antigravity and your Gemini key instead.
